assumptions: no phase change over the rise

defect_reasons.missing_assumption: The initial-temperature invariance (claimed C) holds only while the water stays liquid (T0 + 40 K below 373.15 K at 1 atm and T0 above freezing); the assumptions list does not state 'no phase change', though all certified values 283-303 K satisfy it.

counterexamples: Outside the tested values: T0 = 350 K would require boiling above 373 K and the time would no longer be m c dT / P.
